items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Well, Louis Armstrong's neck comes out so far and George Brunus' whole face comes out.

ctx.x: When he blew he evidently either had, it was a bad embouchure or he was instructed wrong. But his neck would swell way out and one side of his face would puff way out. Now it may have helped him sustain the note, you know, to have all that extra air there. But he looked funny as a dickens.
Well, Louis Armstrong's neck comes out so far and George Brunus' whole face comes out.
And what's the matter with big Jim Robinson? Yeah, he comes out. He's got two pouches on the side of his face that come out.
